"import csv
from openpyxl import Workbook


def main():
    data = {}  # (config, channel) -> max value
    configs = set()
    channels = set()

    with open("eng_pivot_02.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            config = row["config"].strip()
            channel = row["channel"].strip()
            value = float(row["value"])
            configs.add(config)
            channels.add(channel)
            key = (config, channel)
            if key not in data or value > data[key]:
                data[key] = value

    sorted_channels = sorted(channels)
    headers = ["config"] + sorted_channels

    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "SUMMARY"
    ws.append(headers)

    for config in sorted(configs):
        out_row = [config]
        for ch in sorted_channels:
            key = (config, ch)
            if key in data:
                out_row.append(round(data[key], 3))
            else:
                out_row.append(None)
        ws.append(out_row)

    wb.save("output.xlsx")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
